purpose: Held-out / chronological-OOF evidence that a direction (classification) model beats both classification baselines on every consumed horizon; consumed by heuristic_strategy app/direction_naive_gate.py.
design: coordinator design from question 21; mirrors predictor.forecast_naive_evidence.v1 (M04 de164a09) in digest, split and population binding
digest: evidence_sha256 = sha256 of canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':', no NaN) of the record without evidence_sha256

frozen_metric.rule: both strictly better than both baselines
frozen_metric.frozen: declared before selection; never switched after seeing results

population.row_ids_sha256: sha256 of ordered row ids joined by \n
population.label_definition: e.g. close[t+h] > close[t], ties excluded or assigned (state which)

majority_class.definition: always the TRAIN majority class; probability = TRAIN class frequency (finite log-loss)

sign_persistence.definition: the sign of the last observed return at the origin; probability = TRAIN-estimated P(next direction == last direction) (finite log-loss)

eligibility: for every consumed horizon of every consumed family: model.balanced_accuracy > max(baselines.balanced_accuracy) AND model.log_loss < min(baselines.log_loss), strictly; all values finite; a missing or non-finite value, a tie, provenance other than held_out_validation/chronological_oof, test_used or reserved_trading_test true, a digest or declaration mismatch all mean SKIPPED_NOT_BETTER_THAN_NAIVE
missing_values: write null with a reason; never 0, never NaN
